thesis: cost-to-correct should be paid ONCE and not recur over the same facts
why_the_localize_null_matters: finding the error costs ~the same in both arms (see localize_results.json), so the ENTIRE cost-to-correct difference is fix+propagate+recurrence

tax_derive_once.compiled_once: TAX-1 rulebook (byte-verified) -> content-addressed library, no model

cost_curves.scenario: TAX filing-threshold fact shared across cases
cost_curves.asymmetry: framework O(1) vs prose O(3+10)=13; ratio grows without bound in G

cost_curves.scenario: meningitis CSF-correlation fact shared across cases
cost_curves.asymmetry: framework O(1) vs prose O(2+10)=12; ratio grows without bound in G

prose_arm_recurrence: see recurring_cost/ (empirical: plain Claude re-commits the same fact-error across fresh sibling cases; correction does not persist)

prose_arm_recurrence_empirical_haiku.shared_fact: destination_already_owned (the Section 2 override) is dispositive in every override case and beats the Section 1 distance rule.

control_case_HO-2_not_owned.prose_reasoning: Section 1 applies: Theo relocated 90 miles closer (exceeds 50-mile threshold). Section 2 override does not apply because destination property is not pre-owned (he signed a new lease).

framework.policy_interpretation_cost: paid ONCE (1 rulebook derivation; verbatim byte-verified)

prose.policy_interpretation_cost: re-paid on EVERY case (stateless; no persistence layer)

cost_to_correct_curve.asymmetry: framework O(1) paid once, non-recurring; prose O(miss_rate * (M+G)), recurs forever

prose_arm_recurrence_empirical_haiku.persistence_note: each prose call is stateless — correcting one answer cannot lower the miss-rate on the next independent case; the framework override, once written, makes the miss-rate 0 for all present and future cases.

recurrence_capability_graded_finding: recurring error appears as model capability drops: a small model misses the buried override and re-misses it on every case (stateless), so the prose miss-rate persists and the cost recurs over the same fact; the framework derived the override once and is 0-error on all cases at 0 answer-time model calls.
